top_signals.title: Odd Lots: How El Niños Actually Work
top_signals.summary:
Forecasters are predicting record-breaking intensity for this year's emerging El Niño. But how do El Niños actually work?

On this episode of the Odd Lots podcast, Justin Mankin, professor of geography at Dartmouth, joins Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway to explain this weather phenomenon, using a space heater as an analogy. (Source: Bloomberg)
